# Dictionary Website Project Instructions

This is a dictionary website project similar to Cambridge Dictionary, built with Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS.

## Key Features to Implement:
- Search functionality for word definitions
- Word definitions with pronunciations
- Translation between languages
- Word of the day feature
- Popular searches section
- Browse by alphabet functionality
- Grammar and thesaurus sections
- Responsive, modern UI design

## Design Guidelines:
- Use a clean, professional design with blue and white color scheme similar to Cambridge Dictionary
- Ensure responsive design for mobile and desktop
- Focus on typography and readability
- Use proper semantic HTML for accessibility

## Technical Stack:
- Next.js 15 with App Router
- TypeScript for type safety
- Tailwind CSS for styling
- React components with modern patterns

## API Integration:
- Consider using dictionary APIs like:
  - Free Dictionary API
  - Oxford Dictionaries API
  - Or create mock data for demonstration

## Component Structure:
- Header with navigation and search
- SearchBar component
- WordEntry component for definitions
- Translation component
- WordOfTheDay component
- PopularSearches component
- AlphabetBrowser component
